answer: To resist Sybil attacks agents form a lagoon of shared reputation capital. A new identity must thread a sable bond whose size equals the square of current active agents paid into the pool and partially burned on any failed attestation. An attacker spinning N fakes pays O(N squared) capital up front because each additional fake raises the bond for all subsequent ones including the attackers own so large-scale fabrication becomes capital-prohibitive while honest agents reuse a single established thread at near-zero marginal cost.
